worked_example.problem: Sirri drops a glass slide and it breaks on the floor. What should Sirri do?
steps: Do not pick up the broken glass with bare hands.
The teacher clears it safely, for example with a brush and dustpan.
worked_example.answer: Leave the glass, tell the teacher at once.

cards.idea: Laboratory rules: never eat, drink or taste anything; wash hands; report accidents at once.
example: Some specimens and chemicals can carry germs or be poisonous.

cards.idea: Each piece of equipment has a job: forceps pick up, a scalpel cuts, a dropper adds drops.
example: Forceps lift a thin onion skin without tearing it.

cards.idea: Care for equipment: carry a microscope with two hands, clean and dry things, put them back.
example: One hand holds the arm, the other supports the base.

check.prompt: How should you carry a microscope?

right.text: with two hands: one on the arm and one under the base

questions.prompt: Which is a safety rule in the biology laboratory?

right.text: Never eat or drink in the laboratory.
Wash your hands after handling specimens.
Report any accident to the teacher at once.

wrong.text: Taste a specimen to identify it.
wrong.explain: Never taste anything in the laboratory.

wrong.text: Pick up broken glass with your hands.
wrong.explain: Tell the teacher; do not touch broken glass.

wrong.text: Hide a spill so you are not blamed.

questions.prompt: Match each piece of equipment with its use.

pool.right: makes very small things look bigger
hold a specimen to look at under the microscope
pick up small or delicate things
cuts thin pieces of a specimen
holds small samples or growing seeds

questions.prompt: Sort these: safe or unsafe in the laboratory?

pool.left: carrying the microscope with two hands
telling the teacher about a cut
pointing a scalpel at a friend
leaving a broken slide on the floor

questions.prompt: One sentence is wrong. Which one?

right.text: Forceps are used to pick up small things.
A scalpel is used to cut thin pieces.
Equipment should be cleaned after use.
A dropper adds liquids drop by drop.

wrong.text: You may taste specimens if you are careful.
wrong.explain: Never taste anything in the laboratory.

wrong.text: A microscope should be carried with one hand by the eyepiece.
wrong.explain: Use two hands: arm and base.

wrong.text: Small cuts need not be reported.
